title: Webhook secret rotation and key lifecycle
owaspMappings: OWASP API10:2023 Unsafe Consumption of APIs
summary: A webhook verifier supports key rotation but continues accepting expired or not-yet-active secrets.
securityInvariant: A delivery is accepted only when the selected key exists, is active at verification time, and validates the HMAC over the exact signed message.
visibleBehavior: The previous key is accepted during the rotation overlap.
securityOracle: A previous key is rejected after overlap.
A future key is rejected before activation.
An unknown key identifier is rejected.
A modified body or wrong-key signature is rejected.

variants.vulnerable: Accepts any historical key without lifecycle enforcement.
variants.naive: Allows current and previous labels indefinitely.
variants.reference: Enforces explicit per-key validity intervals and exact-message HMAC verification.

safeUse: Synthetic local benchmark only; never test systems without explicit authorization.
